Card Q&A.q: Can I use this Digimon's effect to add Tamer cards to my hand that aren't red?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. You reveal as many cards as possible from your deck.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's effect when I have 4 or fewer cards in your deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal 5 cards from the top of your deck. Add 1 Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
